info.name: Pioneer DDJ-1000
info.author: Serhii O. Pashchenko
info.description: 4-deck mapping for the Pioneer DDJ-1000: all eight pad modes, jog displays, BEAT FX, SOUND COLOR FX, memory cues and loop adjust.

option.label: Let the controller mix cue and main in the headphones
option.description: The DDJ-1000 blends the cue mix (outputs 3-4) with main (outputs 1-2) using its HEADPHONES MIX knob. When on, Mixxx's own headphone mix is set to cue only so the knob on the controller behaves as labelled.

option.label: Tempo range when the mapping starts
COLOR knobs only work while a SOUND COLOR FX button is on
option.description: Off: the COLOR knobs always control each deck's Quick Effect. On: they do nothing until a SOUND COLOR FX button is lit, as in rekordbox.

option.label: DUB ECHO button: Quick Effect preset number (0 = keep)
PITCH button: Quick Effect preset number (0 = keep)
NOISE button: Quick Effect preset number (0 = keep)
FILTER button: Quick Effect preset number (0 = keep)
